purpose: Track high-value government documents whose official file URLs are broken and may be recoverable through the Internet Archive.

items.title: Official 2022 Near Heights Planning Assessment
items.reason_high_value: Provides official planning context, project history, objectives, cost-estimate work, and funding status for the 2022 Girard Streetscape schematic design.
items.recovery_notes: Useful corroborating planning-history record. It is not the same file as the contributed annotated Girard schematic design.

items.title: City of Albuquerque Elementary & Middle School Crossing Evaluation (2019)
items.reason_high_value: Defines the school-crossing evaluation methodology and documents findings that explain the City's public dashboard classifications.
items.recovery_notes: Recovered copy was contributed locally, hashed, archived byte-for-byte in R2, and added to ABQInfo. Add the exact Internet Archive capture URL when available.

items.title: Albuquerque Vision Zero Action Plan (2021)
items.reason_high_value: The City's foundational adopted traffic-safety action plan establishes policy, actions, measures, and implementation history.
items.recovery_notes: Recovered copy was contributed locally, hashed, archived byte-for-byte in R2, and added to ABQInfo.

items.title: I-25 Bicycle Accessibility Study Summary (2020; Updated 2021)
